summary: Private or hidden ordinary yields are not automatically AI-only or economically inert. Native citizen allocation and ordinary output can be affected. Retain the actual role/profile and attachment controls when interpreting a test.

The earlier PLAYER_PLOT_YIELDS city-iterator mapping was corrected on 3 November. PLAYER_PLOT_YIELDS and SINGLE_PLOT_YIELDS consume an already supplied plot pointer once. Direct inspected empty contexts and actual live/nested contexts must remain distinct.

Later Builder consumer analysis links Units.Value to additive request priority. Keep that field separate from the extra present value used in queue comparisons. The earlier unresolved link is historical.

The old cold-start validation pending status is qualified by the two later placement diagnostic startups, which verified helper modules and methods. This closes startup capability only; it establishes neither a useful district decision capture nor improved chain outcomes.

Finite failure to re-adopt a stopped strategy is not permanent irreversibility. Later Ancient-series observations include natural re-adoption 20 turns after stopping. Preserve the tested strategy, era, gates and observation window.

Both early placement diagnostics are closed. Callback volume exceeded the cost gate; no useful target choice was captured and no weights were changed. Historical live/pending sections authorise no retry, and the broad optimisation campaign remains paused.

Full-supply milestones and Service/link flags are not a profit calculation. Upstream materials and producers may supply partial benefits; absent full milestones do not imply zero return. Single joint-package comparisons, partial observation and censored late investments limit causal claims.

A native component need not require a separate launcher or manual executable-folder DLL copy. Civ VI GameCores PackageId/DllPrefix loads native code from mod packages, as installed Workshop CE and the independent delivery prototype demonstrate. CE console INI placement is optional configuration, not the DLL installation requirement. Stock CE still lacks the proposed qualified district-score API.
